method: GOES-16 ABI L2 CMIP band 13; positions in km east/north of frame_centre, navigated at the cloud top (parallax-corrected); anvil = connected <= -50 C region touching the storm; OT after Bedka et al. 2010

overshooting_tops.note: diameter is resolution-limited: one 2 km ABI pixel is ~2.5-3.5 km here, so OTs under ~5 km look ~5 km
